# Palocap — custom clothing in Milan since 1998

> Palocap is a shop in central Milan (Corso di Porta Ticinese 1, by the Colonne di San Lorenzo, plus a second shop, Palocap2, at Piazza Piemonte 10) that embroiders, prints and hand-paints t-shirts, hoodies, polos, caps and jackets to order. Founded in 1998. Minimum order: one piece. Walk-ins welcome; free quote in five minutes at the counter. Rated 4.9/5 on Google (31 reviews).

## What they do
- Embroidery (thread on fabric, own machines in the shop): caps, hoodies, polos — permanent, does not peel or fade
- Print: t-shirts and hoodies with large designs and solid colours — best from about 10 pieces (teams, staff, events)
- Hand-painting: one-of-a-kind pieces, brush on garment — ideal for gifts
- Group / team uniforms since 2012: same design across garments and sizes (men, women, kids), different name or number on each piece
- Customers can bring their own garment or choose one from the shop
- Any image is accepted as a starting point; vector files (AI, EPS, PDF) give the cleanest embroidery; the shop redraws logos if needed
- Palocap also designed and produced its own technical sportswear collections in the 2000s (archive on the site)

## Practical
- Phone: +39 02 8901 2340 — Email: palocap@palocap.com — Instagram: @palocap_ and @palocap_due
- Porta Ticinese 1 (20123 Milano): Mon 16:00–19:00, Tue–Sat 10:00–19:00, Sun closed
- Piazza Piemonte 10 (20145 Milano): Mon 15:00–19:15, Tue–Sat 10:00–19:15, Sun closed
- Prices depend on garment, technique and quantity — ask for a free quote in person, by phone or by email
- Languages: Italian site at https://www.palocap.com/ — English site at https://www.palocap.com/en/
